messages.content: Good morning — this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How have you been since last week? Have you had a chance to take your blood pressure reading today?
Took it twice this morning. Kept coming up around 168 over 102. Also got a pretty bad headache that started when I woke up.

Thank you for checking twice — that's helpful. I've logged both of those readings. A headache alongside numbers in that range is something I need to take seriously. Are you sitting down somewhere safe right now?
Yeah I'm at home. Took my lisinopril with breakfast same as always. Just feels off today.

I've logged that you took your lisinopril this morning. Because of where those readings landed and the headache, I'm connecting you with a nurse now. The median response time is currently 31 hours — they'll reach out to you directly at this number. If anything gets worse before then — chest tightness, trouble speaking, vision changes — please call 911.
31 hours is a long wait. Can you at least tell me if I should take an extra dose or something?

I can't advise on that — medication decisions are exactly what the nurse is there for, and they'll have your full history when they reach you. I've gone ahead and scheduled your next regular check-in for next week. Please don't hesitate to reply here if anything changes before the nurse gets back to you.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
